own_solution.law: Coulomb's law with charge conservation and equal sharing between identical conductors

notes: Recomputed R answers: 16*(60/74)^2 = 10.5186, 16*(60/86)^2 = 7.7880, 16*(60/105)^2 = 5.2245 mN; base 16 mN. Relations F = F0*((rq-1)/2)^2/rq*(d0/d1)^2 give 80*0.2 = 16 mN. In pass 1 I labelled the radius sentences K (point-charge regime); the authors' C (radius enters the capacitance-proportional charge sharing and cancels for equal radii) is also correct, and with the point-charge instruction given in the text both labels give the same invariant answer; I accept C. For radii up to 4 cm at 30-60 cm the point-charge treatment the problem instructs is reasonable. Minimal pairs TA88E/T2BDE (blocks vs spheres) and T0EF1/TFAEF (earlier experiment vs afterwards) keep 26 cm and differ only in attachment. Numeral-free twins T162F, TCCA9 are by design.
